reference_float_tanh.note: integer datapath with a floating-point tanh; not synthesizable

full_table.note: odd symmetry only; 1 LSB comes from two's-complement asymmetry (-32768 has no positive counterpart)

selected.note: smallest table that matches the float-tanh reference agreement; 500x smaller than the full table

breakdown_point.note: accuracy holds down to ~18 entries, then collapses

sat1_step64.note: same entry count as the selected table but cut at |z|>=1; reproduces the ablation's config B (0.8789), i.e. the Q1.15 pre-activation saturation

findings: table size is governed by where |z| is cut, not by how finely it is sampled
interpolation is nearly free: 256-step interpolation keeps the reference agreement
cutting at |z|>=1 recreates the Q1.15 saturation failure measured in the ablation
